result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues where content cards are being truncated at the edges of the screen, preventing users from viewing complete information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off on the right side, with the card extending beyond the viewport boundary
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel container to ensure all cards fit within the viewport width, or implement proper horizontal scrolling with visible scroll indicators

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is vertically truncated at the bottom, hiding the restaurant name and key details
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card height and overflow are properly managed so full content (image, name, rating, delivery time) is visible without cutting off below the fold
